title: Ticket 1.62.4 — food page dark mode, traffic edit history filter, centered dashboard, manual ticket select-all
notes: Cumulative offline update, no database migration. Dark mode now fully covers the food menu/planning page surfaces (forms, person lists, bulk tools, recipient banner) in both the host stylesheet and the standalone panel stylesheet. The traffic-control edit history tab lists only records whose values were actually edited (action='updated'); exit registrations and deletions are still audited but no longer shown there. The food management dashboard host is full-bleed while regular panel pages are centered with margin-inline auto. The manual ticket registration list opens with no pre-checked names and gains a select-all checkbox in the «انتخاب» header column that toggles all eligible visible employees. CSS/theme fixes are statically verified only — no browser or production validation was possible in this environment.
